mapper.select: SELECT pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.space s WHERE s.id=#{actor.spaceId} AND s.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND s.type='PERSONAL')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace w WHERE w.id=#{workspace} AND w.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND w.actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND w.state='READY')
SELECT action,request_hash,resource_id FROM pf.knowledge_mutation_request WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{request}
SELECT * FROM pf.knowledge_base WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND id=#{id} AND state='ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM pf.knowledge_base WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND state='ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT 100

SELECT e.id AS extraction_id,e.source_kind,e.workspace_id,e.file_id,e.version_id,e.attachment_id,e.source_asset_id,e.source_sha256, e.output_sha256,e.output_bytes,e.output_object_key,COALESCE(fe.name,a.filename) AS name,e.source_format FROM pf.document_extraction e LEFT JOIN pf.file_entry fe ON fe.space_id=e.space_id AND fe.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND fe.id=e.file_id LEFT JOIN pf.chat_attachment a ON a.space_id=e.space_id AND a.id=e.attachment_id WHERE e.id=#{extraction} AND e.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND e.actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND e.status='READY' AND e.requested_format='TEXT_EXTRACT' AND e.output_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152 AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.knowledge_base b WHERE b.id=#{base} AND b.space_id=e.space_id AND b.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND b.state='ACTIVE') AND ((e.source_kind='FILE_VERSION' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace w JOIN pf.file_version v ON v.space_id=w.space_id AND v.workspace_id=w.id AND v.file_id=e.file_id AND v.id=e.version_id WHERE w.id=e.workspace_id AND w.space_id=e.space_id AND w.actor_id=#{actor.userId})) OR (e.source_kind='CHAT_ATTACHMENT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.chat_attachment a2 WHERE a2.id=e.attachment_id AND a2.space_id=e.space_id AND a2.actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND a2.status='AVAILABLE')))

SELECT d.id,d.knowledge_base_id,d.source_kind,d.file_id,d.version_id,d.attachment_id,d.extraction_id,d.display_name,d.status,d.active_index_version,d.source_sha256,d.revision FROM pf.knowledge_document d LEFT JOIN pf.file_entry fe ON fe.space_id=d.space_id AND fe.workspace_id=d.workspace_id AND fe.id=d.file_id LEFT JOIN pf.chat_attachment a ON a.space_id=d.space_id AND a.id=d.attachment_id WHERE d.id=#{id} AND d.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND d.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND d.status<>'DELETED' AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) AND (d.workspace_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace w WHERE w.id=d.workspace_id AND w.space_id=d.space_id AND w.actor_id=#{actor.userId}))

SELECT d.id,d.knowledge_base_id,d.source_kind,d.file_id,d.version_id,d.attachment_id,d.extraction_id,d.display_name,d.status,d.active_index_version,d.source_sha256,d.revision FROM pf.knowledge_document d JOIN pf.knowledge_base b ON b.id=d.knowledge_base_id AND b.space_id=d.space_id LEFT JOIN pf.file_entry fe ON fe.space_id=d.space_id AND fe.workspace_id=d.workspace_id AND fe.id=d.file_id LEFT JOIN pf.chat_attachment a ON a.space_id=d.space_id AND a.id=d.attachment_id WHERE d.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND d.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND d.knowledge_base_id=#{base} AND d.status<>'DELETED' AND b.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND b.state='ACTIVE' AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC,d.id LIMIT 500
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.knowledge_document SET status=CASE WHEN active_index_version IS NULL THEN 'QUEUED' ELSE 'BUILDING' END,revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{document} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND status IN('READY','FAILED') AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId})

UPDATE pf.knowledge_document SET status='DELETED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{document} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND status<>'DELETED' AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId})
mapper.select: WITH picked AS (SELECT o.id FROM pf.knowledge_index_outbox o WHERE o.state='PENDING' OR (o.state='PUBLISHING' AND o.relay_until<clock_timestamp()) OR (o.state='PUBLISHED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.knowledge_index_build b WHERE b.id=o.build_id AND b.generation=o.generation AND b.state='RUNNING' AND b.lease_until<=clock_timestamp())) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), claimed AS ( UPDATE pf.knowledge_index_outbox o SET state='PUBLISHING',relay_owner=#{owner},relay_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '15 seconds' FROM picked p WHERE o.id=p.id RETURNING o.id,o.build_id,o.space_id,o.generation,o.relay_owner) SELECT * FROM claimed
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.knowledge_index_outbox SET state=CASE WHEN #{confirmed} THEN 'PUBLISHED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, relay_owner=CASE WHEN #{confirmed} THEN relay_owner ELSE NULL END,relay_until=NULL WHERE id=#{item.id} AND build_id=#{item.buildId} AND generation=#{item.generation} AND relay_owner=#{item.relayOwner}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.knowledge_index_outbox WHERE id=#{item.id} AND build_id=#{item.buildId} AND space_id=#{item.spaceId} AND generation=#{item.generation} AND relay_owner=#{item.relayOwner} AND (state='PUBLISHED' OR (state='PUBLISHING' AND relay_until>clock_timestamp())))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.knowledge_index_inbox WHERE event_id=#{item.id} AND build_id=#{item.buildId})
SELECT state,coalesce(lease_until>clock_timestamp(),false) AS lease_live FROM pf.knowledge_index_build WHERE id=#{item.buildId} AND space_id=#{item.spaceId} AND generation=#{item.generation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.knowledge_index_delivery_quarantine(id,body_hash) VALUES(#{id},#{hash}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO pf.knowledge_index_inbox(event_id,build_id) VALUES(#{item.id},#{item.buildId}) ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT kind,reference_id,generation,owner_id,fence,revision FROM pf.heavy_runtime_slot WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.heavy_runtime_slot SET kind='KNOWLEDGE',reference_id=#{build},generation=#{generation},owner_id=#{owner},fence=fence+1, lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND (kind IS NULL OR (kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND reference_id=#{build} AND generation=#{generation} AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp()) OR (kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp() AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.knowledge_index_build b WHERE b.id=pf.heavy_runtime_slot.reference_id AND b.state='RUNNING' AND b.lease_until>clock_timestamp())))

UPDATE pf.heavy_runtime_slot SET kind=NULL,reference_id=NULL,generation=NULL,owner_id=NULL,revision=revision+1 ,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=1 AND kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND reference_id=#{command.buildId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND fence=#{command.fence}
mapper.select: UPDATE pf.heavy_runtime_slot SET kind='KNOWLEDGE',reference_id=#{query},generation=1,owner_id=#{owner},fence=fence+1, lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND (kind IS NULL OR(kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp() AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.knowledge_index_build b WHERE b.id=pf.heavy_runtime_slot.reference_id AND b.state='RUNNING' AND b.lease_until>clock_timestamp()))) RETURNING fence

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.heavy_runtime_slot WHERE id=1 AND kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND reference_id=#{query} AND owner_id=#{owner} AND fence=#{fence} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}))
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.heavy_runtime_slot SET kind=NULL,reference_id=NULL,generation=NULL,owner_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=1 AND kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND reference_id=#{query} AND owner_id=#{owner} AND fence=#{fence}

UPDATE pf.knowledge_index_build b SET state='RUNNING',owner_id=#{owner},fence=#{fence},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM pf.knowledge_document d WHERE b.id=#{item.buildId} AND b.space_id=#{item.spaceId} AND b.generation=#{item.generation} AND (b.state='QUEUED' OR(b.state='RUNNING' AND b.lease_until<=clock_timestamp())) AND d.id=b.document_id AND d.space_id=b.space_id AND d.status IN('QUEUED','BUILDING') AND d.owner_user_id=(SELECT owner_user_id FROM pf.knowledge_base WHERE id=d.knowledge_base_id) AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(d.owner_user_id,d.space_id)
mapper.select: SELECT b.id,b.id AS build_id,b.document_id,b.index_version,b.space_id,d.owner_user_id AS actor_id,b.owner_id,b.generation,b.fence,b.lease_until,d.extraction_id, e.output_object_key,e.output_bytes,e.output_sha256,d.source_kind,e.source_format,d.display_name,v.model_sha256,v.tokenizer_sha256 FROM pf.knowledge_index_build b JOIN pf.knowledge_document d ON d.id=b.document_id AND d.space_id=b.space_id JOIN pf.knowledge_index_version v ON v.space_id=b.space_id AND v.document_id=b.document_id AND v.index_version=b.index_version JOIN pf.document_extraction e ON e.id=d.extraction_id AND e.space_id=d.space_id AND e.status='READY' LEFT JOIN pf.file_entry fe ON fe.space_id=d.space_id AND fe.workspace_id=d.workspace_id AND fe.id=d.file_id LEFT JOIN pf.chat_attachment a ON a.space_id=d.space_id AND a.id=d.attachment_id WHERE b.id=#{build} AND b.state='RUNNING'
mapper.update: WITH renewed AS(UPDATE pf.knowledge_index_build SET next_ordinal=GREATEST(next_ordinal,#{ordinal}),lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{command.buildId} AND state='RUNNING' AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() RETURNING id) UPDATE pf.heavy_runtime_slot h SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds' WHERE h.id=1 AND h.kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND h.reference_id=#{command.buildId} AND h.owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND h.generation=#{command.generation} AND h.fence=#{command.fence} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM renewed)

WITH renewed AS(UPDATE pf.knowledge_index_build SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{command.buildId} AND state='RUNNING' AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() RETURNING id) UPDATE pf.heavy_runtime_slot h SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds' WHERE h.id=1 AND h.kind='KNOWLEDGE' AND h.reference_id=#{command.buildId} AND h.owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND h.generation=#{command.generation} AND h.fence=#{command.fence} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM renewed)

UPDATE pf.knowledge_index_version SET state='READY',chunk_count=#{count},content_manifest_sha256=#{manifest},completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND document_id=#{command.documentId} AND index_version=#{command.indexVersion} AND state='BUILDING'
UPDATE pf.knowledge_index_version SET state='RETIRED' WHERE space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND document_id=#{command.documentId} AND index_version<>#{command.indexVersion} AND state='READY'

UPDATE pf.knowledge_document SET active_index_version=#{command.indexVersion},status='READY',revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND id=#{command.documentId} AND owner_user_id=#{command.actorId} AND status IN('QUEUED','BUILDING') AND extraction_id=#{command.extractionId}

UPDATE pf.knowledge_index_build SET state='COMMITTED',owner_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{command.buildId} AND state='RUNNING' AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence}
UPDATE pf.knowledge_index_version SET state='FAILED' WHERE space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND document_id=#{command.documentId} AND index_version=#{command.indexVersion} AND state='BUILDING'

UPDATE pf.knowledge_document SET status=CASE WHEN active_index_version IS NULL THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'READY' END,revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND id=#{command.documentId} AND owner_user_id=#{command.actorId} AND status<>'DELETED'

UPDATE pf.knowledge_index_build SET state='FAILED',owner_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code=#{error},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{command.buildId} AND state='RUNNING' AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence}
mapper.select: WITH eligible_documents AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT d.space_id,d.id AS document_id,d.active_index_version AS index_version,d.source_kind,d.version_id,d.attachment_id,d.source_sha256,d.display_name AS name FROM pf.knowledge_document d JOIN pf.knowledge_base b ON b.space_id=d.space_id AND b.id=d.knowledge_base_id AND b.owner_user_id=d.owner_user_id AND b.state='ACTIVE' JOIN pf.knowledge_index_version iv ON iv.space_id=d.space_id AND iv.document_id=d.id AND iv.index_version=d.active_index_version AND iv.state='READY' WHERE d.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND d.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND d.knowledge_base_id IN #{baseId} AND d.status IN('READY','BUILDING') AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) AND ((d.source_kind='FILE_VERSION' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_version fv JOIN pf.workspace w ON w.id=fv.workspace_id AND w.space_id=fv.space_id WHERE fv.space_id=d.space_id AND fv.workspace_id=d.workspace_id AND fv.file_id=d.file_id AND fv.id=d.version_id AND w.actor_id=#{actor.userId})) OR (d.source_kind='CHAT_ATTACHMENT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.chat_attachment ca WHERE ca.id=d.attachment_id AND ca.space_id=d.space_id AND ca.actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND ca.status='AVAILABLE'))) ), sem AS ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT ed.space_id,ed.document_id,ed.index_version,c.ordinal,c.body,c.source_location, ed.source_kind,ed.version_id,ed.attachment_id,ed.source_sha256,ed.name, row_number() OVER(ORDER BY c.embedding OPERATOR(pf.<=>) CAST(#{vector,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS pf.vector),c.document_id,c.ordinal) AS rnk FROM eligible_documents ed JOIN pf.knowledge_index_chunk c ON c.space_id=ed.space_id AND c.document_id=ed.document_id AND c.index_version=ed.index_version WHERE CAST(#{vector,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS text) IS NOT NULL AND c.embedding OPERATOR(pf.<=>) CAST(#{vector,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS pf.vector) <= 0.20 ORDER BY c.embedding OPERATOR(pf.<=>) CAST(#{vector,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS pf.vector),c.document_id,c.ordinal LIMIT 20) ranked ), lex AS ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT ed.space_id,ed.document_id,ed.index_version,c.ordinal,c.body,c.source_location, ed.source_kind,ed.version_id,ed.attachment_id,ed.source_sha256,ed.name, row_number() OVER(ORDER BY ts_rank(c.normalized,plainto_tsquery('simple',#{query})) DESC,c.document_id,c.ordinal) AS rnk FROM eligible_documents ed JOIN pf.knowledge_index_chunk c ON c.space_id=ed.space_id AND c.document_id=ed.document_id AND c.index_version=ed.index_version WHERE (c.normalized @@ plainto_tsquery('simple',#{query}) OR c.normalized @@ plainto_tsquery('simple',#{term})) ORDER BY ts_rank(c.normalized,plainto_tsquery('simple',#{query})) DESC,c.document_id,c.ordinal LIMIT 20) ranked ), fused AS ( SELECT COALESCE(s.space_id,l.space_id) space_id,COALESCE(s.document_id,l.document_id) document_id,COALESCE(s.index_version,l.index_version) index_version, COALESCE(s.ordinal,l.ordinal) ordinal,COALESCE(s.body,l.body) body,COALESCE(s.source_location,l.source_location) source_location, COALESCE(s.source_kind,l.source_kind) source_kind,COALESCE(s.version_id,l.version_id) version_id,COALESCE(s.attachment_id,l.attachment_id) attachment_id, COALESCE(s.source_sha256,l.source_sha256) source_sha256,COALESCE(s.name,l.name) name, COALESCE(1.0/(60+s.rnk),0)+COALESCE(1.0/(60+l.rnk),0) score FROM sem s FULL OUTER JOIN lex l ON l.space_id=s.space_id AND l.document_id=s.document_id AND l.index_version=s.index_version AND l.ordinal=s.ordinal ) SELECT document_id,index_version,source_kind,version_id,attachment_id,name,body,source_location::text AS source_location,score,source_sha256 FROM fused ORDER BY score DESC,document_id,ordinal LIMIT #{limit}
